# criblio_search_datasets (Data Source)

Returns all matching objects in `items`, following API pagination automatically. Scope the request using the required attributes below. An empty collection returns an empty list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "criblio_search_datasets" "example" {
}
```

### Nested Schema for `items.aws_security_lake_dataset.metadata`

Read-Only:

- `earliest` (String) Rolling time window that defines how far back acceleration scans. Required when enable_acceleration is true (for example, -30d).
- `enable_acceleration` (Boolean) If <code>true</code>, the system automatically backfills and refreshes Dataset metadata. Otherwise, <code>false</code>.
- `field_list` (List of String) Fields for which acceleration gathers statistics. Required when scan mode is <code>detailed</code>.
- `latest_run_info` (Attributes) Details from the most recent acceleration scan. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--aws_security_lake_dataset--metadata--latest_run_info))
- `scan_mode` (String) Acceleration scan mode. <code>quick</code> collects object-level metadata; <code>detailed</code> also collects field-level statistics.
